title: Doozy Vape Co Temptations Banana Split Nic Salt 10ml E-Liquid
description: Banana Split from Doozy Temptations is a deliciously indulgent dessert flavour featuring layers of sweet, smooth bananas sliced over rich, unctuous clotted cream. Doozy Temptation’s 50/VG/50PG formulation delivers the perfect balance of flavour and cloud production while the nicotine salt formulation ensures a super-smooth and comfortable throat sensation. These e-liquids are perfect for use in starter vape kits and low-powered pod devices. Unlike regular freebase e-liquids, nicotine salts’ alkaline formulation allows for a higher concentration of nicotine while delivering a smoother throat hit than high-strength freebase liquids are capable of. With nicotine salt e-liquids, the nicotine is absorbed into the bloodstream faster, providing near-instant relief from nicotine cravings. This makes Nic salt e-liquids a great choice for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by Nic salts. Temptations is an irresistible new collection of e-liquids from Doozy Vape Co that offers five deliciously decadent and nostalgic dessert flavours for vapers to indulge their sweet tooth with. Available in super-satisfying 10ml nic salts and long-lasting 100ml shortfills, Doozy Temptations are the latest flavours from the award-winning brand to get vapers’ tastebuds tingling, and a blissful way to enjoy your favourite sweet treats, guilt-free. If you love this flavour, why not treat yourself to the others in Doozy Vape Co’s Temptations collection? From smooth and creamy Strawberry Milk to sweet and buttery Jam Tart, to silky-rich Ice Cream Cake and warm and comforting Muffin Delight, Temptations are far too delicious to resist going back for more.
